# Pandamonium v1.0.51

This release turns Pandamonium's Projects panel into a real agent workstation and gives the Add Local Models picker the speech endpoint types the voice stack already understands. Projects are now actual directories the installation's agent can create and work in, with a hover action that starts a session already bound to that folder — no Codex mount and no remote directory required.

## MAD-901 — Settings: Add Local Models supports STT and TTS endpoint types

### Problem

The Add Local Models type select only offered LLM and Image, and the endpoint contract only accepted `model_type` llm/image. An installation could not register a local speech server as a first-class endpoint even though the voice stack already consumes `endpoint:<id>` providers for STT and TTS.

### Implementation

The type select now offers LLM, Image, STT, and TTS. Endpoint create and update normalize and validate the type through `normalize_model_endpoint_type()`; unknown values return 400 instead of being stored. The create response now includes `model_type`. Non-llm endpoints no longer seed the default chat model, no longer autoselect through `odysseus:auto-select-model`, and are skipped by the composer fallback paths, so a speech server that lists voices or models cannot become the chat model.

### Product value and UI visibility

An operator can configure a Whisper-family STT server or a TTS server from the same Add Local Models card as chat and image endpoints, and then select it in the voice settings as `endpoint:<id>`. The type is visible in the select and in the saved endpoint list.

### Verification

Route tests cover create and update acceptance for STT/TTS, rejection of unknown types, the default-chat seeding guard, and delete/update behavior. Source guards pin the select options and the chat filters, and the browser spec asserts the four options in Settings → Services.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Additive only: existing llm/image endpoints and chat behavior are unchanged, and unknown types are no longer accepted on write. Deleting an endpoint that a speech setting references uses the existing cleanup path. No new dependency.

### References

- [Linear MAD-901](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-901/settings-add-local-models-supports-stt-and-tts-endpoint-types)
- [Feature PR](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/108)

## MAD-902 — Projects: Pandamonium agent workstation with created or imported project directories

### Problem

The sidebar Projects list showed Codex-discovered folders rather than Pandamonium's own working directories. The installation's agent had no own workstation it could create projects in, and starting work in a known folder meant manually binding a workspace with no persistent project list.

### Implementation

A server-backed project registry (`DATA_DIR/projects.json`) stores projects as real directories. `GET /api/projects` lists them with live availability state; `POST` creates a new folder under the installation projects root or imports an existing folder vetted with the same rules as the chat workspace picker; `DELETE` forgets a project without touching disk. The sidebar gains a Projects section with the registry, a header `+` offering New project / Add existing folder, a hover `+` on each row that binds the project workspace and starts a new session, and drag-handle participation in bucket reordering. The workspace browser gained a picker mode that returns a chosen path without rebinding the chat workspace.

### Product value and UI visibility

The agent's projects are visible, persistent, and tied to real directories on the machine Pandamonium runs on. Creating a project makes the folder; importing reuses an existing one; starting a session from a project binds that workspace automatically. Unavailable folders show an explicit reason and refuse to start a session instead of failing silently later.

### Verification

`tests/test_project_registry.py` and `tests/test_project_routes.py` cover create/import, duplicate and traversal rejection, missing-folder reporting, delete, and admin gating. `tests/browser/mad-902-projects.spec.js` covers the rendered list, availability state, hover new-session workspace binding, the add menu, and the create flow.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Projects default to the installation data directory (`DATA_DIR/projects`) and are admin-gated because the API reveals and creates host paths. Nothing is deleted from disk by delete/rollback. The Codex workspace browser is unchanged and remains separate. No new dependency, no database migration.

### References

- [Linear MAD-902](https://linear.app/madpanda3d/issue/MAD-902/projects-pandamonium-agent-workstation-with-created-or-imported)
- [Feature PR](https://github.com/MADPANDA3D/Pandamonium/pull/111)
